name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::begin, std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::cbegin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the flat_multimap.

If the flat_multimap is empty, the returned iterator will be equal to end().
summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the flat_multimap.
